headline: Chinese robot maker AGIBOT is reportedly close to closing a new funding round that would value it at about 50 billion yuan.
score_reason: Lowered from 7: the valuation comes only from unnamed investors cited by Caijing and the company declined to comment.
importance_line: Investors in Chinese humanoid-robot makers may see a very large valuation, but it rests on unnamed sources and the company has not confirmed it.
summary: TechNode reports, citing investors quoted by the Chinese outlet Caijing, that AGIBOT, a Chinese robot maker founded in 2023, is close to completing a funding round of about 1 billion to 1.5 billion yuan that would value it at around 50 billion yuan. One investor told Caijing the round would push AGIBOT's planned Hong Kong listing past the end of 2026 because of a required 120-day gap before listing, and AGIBOT declined to comment.
notes: Funding report, not a machine in action. Figures are in yuan as reported; no conversion made.
